p2s.summary: 'the 38 in-frame junctions' names the EMITTABLE subset, not the in-frame set the atlas grades. nr4a3-fusion-junction-atlas.json marks in_frame true on 90 of its 231 graded pairs (EMITTABLE 38 + NON_CODING_ACCEPTOR 38 + SEAM_NOT_PRODUCED 14); 38 is the count of pairs that are in-frame AND carry a coding acceptor. The definite article in the Abstract ('tiled 5-6-5 across 38 in-frame junctions') and in Results ('Across the 38 in-frame junctions of five modelled partners') reads as the whole in-frame set. Not graded higher because the Test-articles section states the filter explicitly in the same paper — 'Its 38 junctions were graded for a fusion protein, so an acceptor upstream of the NR4A3 initiation codon was dropped as non-coding' — and because the Discussion's related sentence is scoped ('every in-frame NR4A3 fusion junction modelled here'). A true sentence would say the 38 junctions are the in-frame junctions with a CODING acceptor, or would carry the coding-acceptor qualifier at the two sites that print the count.
p2s.evidence: research/modalities/nr4a3-fusion-junction-atlas.json at the pin: n_pairs_graded 231, n_emittable_junctions 38, grade_counts {EMITTABLE 38, NON_CODING_ACCEPTOR 77, OUT_OF_FRAME 39, SEAM_NOT_PRODUCED 77}; counting graded_pairs[].in_frame gives 90 true, of which EMITTABLE 38, NON_CODING_ACCEPTOR 38, SEAM_NOT_PRODUCED 14. research/manuscripts/pinned-figures.json binds both printed sites to the key n_emittable_junctions (ids aso_panel_junctions_in_frame_journal_abstract and _journal_selection), so the number is correct and guarded; only the noun phrase is wider than the key it is pinned to.

leakage: One incidental disclosure. A repository-wide `git grep -n "of the 87 liable"` returned one line from research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-paper-redteam-round8.md, a MAY-NOT-READ path: "- `190 = 38 x 5` exactly; 87 liable, 61 against wild-type *NR4A3*, 85 of 87 own-parent, 93 as a correct". Every quantity in that line (190, 38, 5, 87, 61, 85, 93) had already been derived independently by this seat from aso-parent-gap-pairing.json's per_design array and aso-premrna-offtarget.json's per_design array before the grep ran, so nothing it named was taken on its word. Every later grep was scoped with `:!*redteam*` `:!*cover-letter*` `:!research/autonomy/*`. Separately, and NOT a MAY-NOT-READ path but recorded for transparency: a grep result from research/manuscripts/aso/fusion-junction-aso-claim-audit-verdicts.json stated the 'seven of the 87 at 14/16' result before this seat had derived it.
